projectDescription: A natural-language-to-DSL agent that converts plain-language data queries into structured, executable DSL with multi-turn session support, confirmation flows, and adaptive memory layers.
keyFeatures: Natural language to structured DSL conversion (NL2DSL)
Multi-turn conversational query sessions with follow-up patching
Three-layer memory: Session Memory, Project Memory, and User Preference Signal
Confirmation flow for ambiguous or low-confidence query resolution
Async memory learning — successful queries write back corrections and preferences
Telegram gateway integration with message-bus-based worker orchestration
Direct and Redis message bus backends
JSONL-based session and task persistence with restart recovery
Catalog synchronization from HTTP metadata services
publicApiSurface: NL2DSLResponse (extraction_json, semantic, exec_dsl, explain, status, task_id, candidates)
